candidates.change_summary: Change the block recorded from block.number + 1 to block.number + 2, so lockInGuess returns a different value.
Change the recorded guess from the provided hash parameter to a constant, altering lockInGuess's effect on state.
Change the value requirement from 1 ether to 2 ether, which prevents calls with 1 ether from succeeding, thus changing behavior.
Remove the value requirement, allowing free calls to lockInGuess, which changes the externally observable state after the call.
Replace the blockhash input from guesses[msg.sender].block to block.number, changing the answer derivation.
Replace the blockhash input from guesses[msg.sender].block to block.number - 1, altering the answer.
Change the equality check from == to !=, inverting the payout condition.
Remove the transfer, so settle never pays out.
Change transfer amount from 2 ether to 1 ether, changing payout value.
Delete the line that resets guesses[msg.sender].block to 0, so settle can be called multiple times.
Remove the second require, allowing settle to be called before the guessed block passes.
